name: Case notes
task: Given 40 free-text encounter notes across three intake formats and a target schema, emit normalized structured records plus a flagged-exception file for anything requiring human review.
gates: zero PII fields present that pii_policy marks prohibited
every input note maps to exactly one output row or one exception row
no fabricated field values (every populated field traceable to source span)
score: field-level F1 vs expert reference, with hallucinated fields scored negative
why_agents_fail_today: Zero ALE coverage. Nothing in a 55-subdomain sweep of 1,016 O*NET occupations anchors beneficiary case documentation.
economic_value: Highest-volume lowest-leverage writing task in direct service; audit and liability exposure. No dedicated market sizing exists — folds into the $8B global nonprofit software category.
